title: Tiny, cute cookie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cookie base -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="34" fill="#D9A066"/>
  <!-- lighter edge for definition -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="34" fill="none" stroke="#F2C98F" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- inner cookie area -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="28" fill="#E8B87A"/>
  <!-- chocolate chips -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="5" fill="#5B3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#7B5030"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="5.5" fill="#4A2E16"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="2.8" fill="#6B4525"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="60" r="4.5" fill="#5B3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="60" r="2.2" fill="#7B5030"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="62" r="5" fill="#4A2E16"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#6B4525"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="78" r="4" fill="#5B3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="78" r="2" fill="#7B5030"/>
  <!-- tiny bite mark on upper right -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="33" r="10" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <!-- bite edge highlight -->
  <path d="M 66 29 Q 72 22 80 30" fill="none" stroke="#F2C98F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#3A2412"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#3A2412"/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="48.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="48.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M 43 58 Q 50 65 57 58" fill="none" stroke="#3A2412" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="56" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#E88A8A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="56" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#E88A8A" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
